mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN ( T2.NODE_ID IN (#{BACK_OPERATOR}, #{BACK_CHECKER}) and CONCAT(',',IFNULL(NEXT_USER,''),',') LIKE concat(concat('%',IFNULL(${userName},'')),'%')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END isTodo FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T1 LEFT JOIN SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE T2 ON T1.SEQ_NO = T2.SEQ_NO WHERE TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and PROCESS_STATE != 'END' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_NODE TT WHERE TT.SEQ_NO = T2.SEQ_NO AND TT.HIS_NO > T2.HIS_NO) AND ACTION_TYPE NOT IN ('delete', 'revoke')
